fields.DESCRIPTION: Invite divine grace and wisdom into your home with this intricately crafted Brass Lord Dattatreya Idol. Lord Dattatreya, revered as the embodiment of the Hindu Trinity—Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh—is depicted here with his sacred cow Kamadhenu, radiating abundance, protection, and spiritual knowledge. Handcrafted in pure brass with a traditional antique finish, this idol is perfect for your pooja room, meditation space, or as an auspicious gift for devotees.
